title: Let's Learn English Lesson 40
subtitle: The Woods Are Alive
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 40: The Woods Are Alive (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Happy New Year! Some people, at the start of a new year, make a resolution -- a promise to yourself to be better. I thought about my resolution carefully. I want to be an actor on the stage! Today I will audition for a show called "The Woods Are Alive!" Wish me luck!
dialogue.zh: 新年快乐！有些人在新年开始时会立下决心——对自己承诺要做得更好。我认真想过我的决心。我想当舞台演员！今天我要去试镜一部叫“树林活了！”的戏。祝我好运！

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: Next! What is your name?
dialogue.zh: 下一位！你叫什么名字？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: My name is Anna Matteo.
dialogue.zh: 我叫安娜·马泰奥。

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: Are you ready to audition?
dialogue.zh: 你准备好试镜了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes.
dialogue.zh: 准备好了。

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: Great. Let's begin on page 1. Here is the story. You are lost in the woods. You are searching desperately for a way out. Suddenly, you hear something.
dialogue.zh: 很好。我们从第 1 页开始。故事是这样的。你在树林里迷路了。你拼命找出路。突然，你听到了什么。

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: Now, say your line.
dialogue.zh: 现在，说你的台词。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: 'What was that? Hello. Is someone there?'
dialogue.zh: “那是什么？你好。有人在吗？”

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: Anna, you are speaking too softly. Can you speak more loudly and a little more, um, seriously?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你说得太轻了。你能说大声一点，再稍微……嗯，严肃一点吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, of course I can. 'What was that? Hello. Is someone there?' Is that loud enough?
dialogue.zh: 当然可以。‘那是什么？你好。有人在吗？’这样够大声吗？

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: Yes, that is loud enough. Let's turn to page 25. In this scene, you are moving slowly and quietly through the woods.
dialogue.zh: 够了。我们翻到第 25 页。这场戏里，你慢慢地、悄悄地穿过树林。

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: Anna. Anna! You are walking quickly and loudly. Walk slowly and quietly.
dialogue.zh: 安娜。安娜！你走得又快又响。慢慢走，悄悄走。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'm walking slowly and quietly. I am walking…
dialogue.zh: 我在慢慢地、悄悄地走。我在走……

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: Anna. Anna. You don't need to say "slowly" and "quietly." Alright, let's try the last scene. Turn to page 48. I say my line first, then you say your line.
dialogue.zh: 安娜。安娜。你不用把“慢慢地”和“悄悄地”说出来。好，我们试最后一场。翻到第 48 页。我先说台词，然后你再说。

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: 'You will never get out of these woods alive! Mwa-ha-ha-ha-ha Mwa-ha-ha-ha-ha!'
dialogue.zh: “你永远走不出这片树林！哇哈哈哈哈 哇哈哈哈哈！”

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: 'Yes, I will.'
dialogue.zh: “不，我会的。”

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: Okay, Anna, you said that line -- you said that line really late. You need to say it earlier.
dialogue.zh: 好，安娜，你那句台词——你说得太晚了。你得说早一点。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sorry. Sorry. Let me try again.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉。抱歉。让我再试一次。

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: 'You will never …'
dialogue.zh: “你永远……”

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: 'Yes, I will.'
dialogue.zh: “不，我会的。”

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: '… get out of the woods alive.'
dialogue.zh: “……走不出这片树林。”

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I was too early, wasn't I?
dialogue.zh: 我太早了，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: Yes. Yes, you were.
dialogue.zh: 对。对，太早了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Director, how am I doing?
dialogue.zh: 导演，我表现得怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: You know, Anna. I think that I have the perfect part for you.
dialogue.zh: 你知道吗，安娜。我想我有一个最适合你的角色。

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: The costume is in the back. Please go try it on.
dialogue.zh: 服装在后面。请去试穿。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Awesome!
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: Oh, Anna, that fits you perfectly!
dialogue.zh: 哦，安娜，这套太适合你了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'm a tree. I'm a tree in … "The Woods Are Alive!" Yes!
dialogue.zh: 我是一棵树。我是“树林活了！”里的一棵树！太好了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: My new year is starting awesomely! Excuse me, Director! I have a great idea for my tree. Oh, wait! Until next time!
dialogue.zh: 我的新年开始得真棒！打扰一下，导演！我对我的树有个好主意。哦，等一下！下次见！

quiz.prompt: What is Anna's New Year resolution?
choices: To be an actor on the stage

quiz.prompt: What show is Anna auditioning for?
